missing: Three refutations. (1) Input hashes are never verified: no validation API exists, and a deserialized fixture whose input was changed while its hash stayed stale is served undetected (vc_201_001_mastery_tampered_input_hash_is_accepted). (2) Held-out membership is not enforced: split is a free-form string, and a fixture labeled 'held-out' escapes held_out() into the train side — the held-out split the evaluator believes isolated is contaminated (vc_201_001_mastery_mislabeled_split_escapes_held_out). (3) Replay is not bound to the revision: replay_seeds ignores revision entirely, so two different revisions yield identical replay plans (vc_201_001_mastery_replay_ignores_revision). Additionally RsiCorpus has no production caller. Holds: the candidate view strips evaluator_expected and keeps seeds (vc_201_001_mastery_candidate_view_hides_evaluator_data).
